{"text":"MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The solder seal connectors fit the wire-joining work suggested by my breadboards, relay, and PCB supplies, so I could see a practical use for them.",
    "Electrical connection supplies recognize part of my interest in assembling small electronics, although the dimensions and intended use still need to fit."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing relates to wiring, but its 30mm diameter looks too large for the small wires suggested by my projects.",
    "The rotary switch needs a specific switching application that my relay and breadboard purchases do not establish.",
    "Polishing wheels and compounds assume a finishing project and suitable tools that my history does not show.",
    "Exam gloves and a COVID test do not serve my current project browsing; glove size and the thousand-glove quantity add further uncertainty.",
    "The inspection mirror and mounting magnets could be useful someday, but I would need a concrete task before choosing them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My tool and component purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any workshop supply, even when it serves a different task.",
    "A shared connection to wiring or mounting seems to count too much when the particular size, function, or application does not fit."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated breadboard, PCB, jumper-wire, and relay purchases give more reason to suggest small electronics assembly supplies than medical or polishing supplies.",
    "Compatibility matters: a related electrical item is only useful if its dimensions and purpose suit the project.",
    "I choose supplies when I can identify a practical use; an occasional purchase of casters or fasteners does not mean I currently need other mounting hardware."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my electronics interests but stretched them into supplies whose purpose or dimensions do not fit my likely projects."
}"}
